queries.name: CAVAS_DOMAIN_COLUMNS
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    c.column_id,
    c.name AS column_name,
    ty.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.precision,
    c.scale,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.is_identity
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.columns c
  ON c.object_id=t.object_id
JOIN sys.types ty
  ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id
WHERE t.name IN ('clients','bottles','bottle_logs','attendances','cellars','cellars_clients','client_notes','users','categories','media','logs')
ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: CAVAS_DOMAIN_INDEXES
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    i.name AS index_name,
    i.is_unique,
    i.is_primary_key,
    c.name AS column_name,
    ic.key_ordinal,
    ic.is_included_column
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.indexes i
  ON i.object_id=t.object_id
JOIN sys.index_columns ic
  ON ic.object_id=i.object_id
 AND ic.index_id=i.index_id
JOIN sys.columns c
  ON c.object_id=ic.object_id
 AND c.column_id=ic.column_id
WHERE t.name IN ('clients','bottles','bottle_logs','attendances','cellars','cellars_clients','client_notes','users','categories','media','logs')
  AND i.index_id>0
ORDER BY t.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal,c.column_id

queries.name: CAVAS_DOMAIN_DEFAULTS
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    c.name AS column_name,
    dc.definition
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.columns c
  ON c.object_id=t.object_id
LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc
  ON dc.parent_object_id=t.object_id
 AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id
WHERE t.name IN ('clients','bottles','bottle_logs','attendances','cellars','cellars_clients','client_notes','users','categories','media','logs')
  AND dc.object_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: CAVAS_DOMAIN_CHECK_CONSTRAINTS
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    cc.name AS constraint_name,
    cc.definition
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.check_constraints cc
  ON cc.parent_object_id=t.object_id
WHERE t.name IN ('clients','bottles','bottle_logs','attendances','cellars','cellars_clients','client_notes','users','categories','media','logs')
ORDER BY t.name,cc.name
